# Tintelle

> Tintelle is a skincare-makeup hybrid brand. Clean, vegan, dermatologist-tested formulas that deliver skin-first color and care in one step.

Tintelle products combine real skincare actives with sheer, buildable color — think tinted serums, lip + cheek tints, hydrating glosses, foundation primers, and luxury cream lipsticks. Every formula is cruelty-free, paraben-free, and made for daily, low-maintenance wear.
